r.notes: walking around looking lost.circled trees and areas a number of times.looking for something or blind?

Female (no scent gland mark) sitting on a very slender, bent tree, about 10 feet off the ground, braced against an even skinnier branch.  Appeared to be sleeping as I approached, turned head at sound of my footsteps. Seemed healthy, not in distress. Photos taken from below show fur matted with what appears to be blood around the pouch and possibly the legs of a very young joey.
